description: Source file implementing tensor range factory functions such as linspace, logspace, arange, and range in the ATen/native namespace for PyTorch.

methods.name: linspace_out
methods.description: Creates a tensor with linearly spaced values between start and end, supporting various input tensor and scalar types.

methods.name: logspace_out
methods.description: Creates a tensor with logarithmically spaced values between start and end, supporting various input tensor and scalar types.

methods.name: range_out
methods.description: Creates a tensor with values in a range defined by start, end, and step, supporting various input scalar types.

methods.name: arange_out
methods.description: Creates a tensor with values in a range with specified start, end, and step, supporting various input scalar types.
